title: A small band with Eddie Miller and the Millers
summary: He joined a six-piece band with Eddie Miller, Benny and Lloyd Miller, Irving Kero and Joe Harris, playing country-town jobs.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Then I got in with a little band with Eddie Miller and the other fellas, three Millers in the band, none of them related.

No, Benny Miller played banjo and guitar, and Lloyd Miller played drums. And you might have heard of Kero, Irving Kero, he played trumpet. He works for the public service now. And we played jobs all the way down to Burris and all over the country towns and all of that.
Was there a trombone playing in the band?
No, no, no, two saxes and trumpet. And drums and piano. Who played the piano? Joe Harris. Harris' finance, he and his brother in the finance business now.
No bass? No bass. No, we didn't need that.
Just two rhythm and, well three rhythm, guitar and piano and drums. Two saxes and trumpet. Did you tell me the drummer? Lloyd Miller. Lloyd Miller, yeah.
Those are new names to me pretty much.
No, those fellas quit playing years ago.
